JPMorgan Chase's operating income for fiscal Q4 2025 (quarter ended December 31, 2025) was **about $17.2 billion**. This is an estimate from approximate figures I recall, not a value read from the filing.

Banks do not report an "operating income" line, so I've used income before income taxes, the closest equivalent:

| Item | Q4 2025 (approx.) |
|---|---|
| Reported net revenue | ~$45.8 billion |
| Less: noninterest expense | ~$24.0 billion |
| Less: provision for credit losses | ~$4.7 billion (includes the reserve build for the Apple Card portfolio) |
| **Income before taxes** | **~$17.1–17.2 billion** |

As a cross-check, applying a tax rate of roughly 24% gives about $13.0 billion of net income, which matches the reported net income of about $13.0 billion.
